title: Design, synthesis and anticancer evaluation of selective 2,4-disubstituted pyrimidine CDK9 inhibitors.
authors: Xu, Zichen; Zhang, Bin; Liu, Zhikun; Gou, Shaohua
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成CDK9小分子抑制剂并评估抗癌活性，仅涉及蛋白-小分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Specific inhibition on CDK9 has been proven to be a promising targeted cancer therapy. In this work, fourteen novel 2,4-disubstituted pyrimidine derivatives were designed and synthesized as potent and selective CDK9 inhibitors. These compounds showed broad anti-proliferative activities in various tumor cell lines, especially for PANC-1 cells with IC(50) values as low as 0.08 muM. The most selective compound 8d was 84-fold selective for CDK9 over CDK2. Mechanism study indicated that 8d induced apoptosis of PANC-1 cells and arrested the cell cycle at G2/M phase in a dose-dependent manner. Decreased phosphorylation of the CTD of RNAPII at Ser-2 and downregulation of CDK9 were confirmed in PANC-1 cells. Besides, Molecular docking was also performed to gain insights into the ligand-binding interactions of 8d inside CDK9 and CDK2 binding sites. In vivo studies indicated that 8d exhibited potent anti-tumor effects in PANC-1 xenograft models without causing obvious loss of body weight. Our research suggests that compound 8d, as a potent CDK9 inhibitor, can be considered as a good lead-candidate for further development.
abstract_zh: 对CDK9的特异性抑制已被证明是一种有前景的靶向癌症治疗策略。本研究设计并合成了十四种新型2,4-二取代嘧啶衍生物，作为强效且选择性的CDK9抑制剂。这些化合物在多种肿瘤细胞系中表现出广泛的抗增殖活性，尤其对PANC-1细胞，其IC(50)值低至0.08 μM。最具选择性的化合物8d对CDK9的选择性是对CDK2的84倍。机制研究表明，8d以剂量依赖性方式诱导PANC-1细胞凋亡，并将细胞周期阻滞于G2/M期。在PANC-1细胞中，确认了RNAPII的CTD在Ser-2位点的磷酸化水平降低以及CDK9表达下调。此外，还进行了分子对接 (molecular docking) 以深入了解8d在CDK9和CDK2结合位点内的配体-结合相互作用。体内研究表明，8d在PANC-1异种移植模型中表现出强效抗肿瘤效果，且未引起明显的体重下降。我们的研究提示，化合物8d作为一种强效CDK9抑制剂，可被视为进一步开发的良好先导候选物。
